Explore this 64.52± acre ranch for sale in Bell County, Texas, offering productive farmland, excellent road frontage, and a convenient location just outside of Holland. Whether you're looking for Texas farmland, a future homesite, an investment property, or a recreational retreat, this versatile tract has plenty to offer.

A farming lease is currently in place, providing immediate agricultural income potential. With approximately 1,400 feet of road frontage on Cathey Creek Road and a location just one mile from Holland, this ranch offers outstanding accessibility while maintaining the privacy and beauty of rural Central Texas.
